name: Macquarie Telecom
summary: Australian telecom group (Macquarie Telecom Group, ASX: MAQ, ACN 056 712 228), founded 1992 by David and Aidan Tudehope. Early corporate carrier arm 'Macquarie Corporate Telecommunications' held the MCT-AU allocation (203.110.128.0/19) in the 1997 IP index. Now a major enterprise telecom/data-centre provider.
